definitions.explanation: A constructed structure such as a house, office building, or temple. A formal and technical term used in official, legal, and architectural contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{建築物|けんちくぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Old buildings are lined up in a row.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{建築物|けんちくぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重要文化財|じゅうようぶんかざい}→重要文化財：14689_juuyoubunkazai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This building is designated as a national important cultural property.

examples.japanese: {耐震基準|たいしんきじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たさない→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧{建築物|けんちくぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{改修|かいしゅう}→改修：12924_kaishuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Buildings that don't meet earthquake resistance standards require renovation.

notes:
A formal and technical term for buildings and structures. Composed of ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧ (construction, architecture) + ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (thing, object). Used in legal documents, regulations, and formal descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧{建築物|けんちくぶつ}: historic building
- ⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧{建築物|けんちくぶつ}: illegal structure
- ⟦{木造|もくぞう}→木造：08328_mokuzou⟧{建築物|けんちくぶつ}: wooden structure
- {建築物|けんちくぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{耐震|たいしん}→耐震：06222_taishin⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧: seismic assessment of a building

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧: building — the standard everyday word
- ⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧: building — typically refers to multi-story commercial buildings
- ⟦{建造物|けんぞうぶつ}→建造物：24301_kenzoubutsu⟧: structure, edifice — legal/technical; broader than {建築物|けんちくぶつ}
- {構造物|こうぞうぶつ}: structure — engineering term covering bridges, dams, etc.

REGISTER:
In everyday speech, ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧ is the natural choice. {建築物|けんちくぶつ} appears in news, laws (e.g., {建築基準法|けんちくきじゅんほう}), and formal writing.
